## Description

Fillet contour terminates at a vertex incident to four edges; the algorithm only supports up to three. Bug-reporter language: "fillet 4-edge corner unsupported", "fillet at high-valence corner fails".

## Reproducer recipe

A box with a smaller box subtracted from the corner so that the corner vertex has four incident edges. Request a fillet on one of them.

## Expected kernel behavior

Reject as unsupported, or generalize to N-edge corners.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `reject`
